intents.label: card_arrival
intents.definition: Enquiries about when a newly ordered or replacement payment card will arrive.

intents.label: card_linking
intents.definition: Enquiries about activating, linking, or reactivating a physical or virtual payment card in the app.

intents.label: card_not_working
intents.definition: Reports that a physical payment card is malfunctioning or failing at terminals or ATMs.

intents.label: declined_card_payment
intents.definition: Enquiries about why a specific card purchase or point-of-sale transaction was declined.

intents.label: lost_or_stolen_card
intents.definition: Urgent reports that a customer's payment card has been misplaced, lost, or stolen.

intents.label: pin_blocked
intents.definition: Requests to unblock a card PIN after entering incorrect PIN attempts.

intents.label: pending_transfer
intents.definition: Enquiries about why an outgoing or incoming bank transfer is still marked as pending.

intents.label: failed_transfer
intents.definition: Reports of bank transfers that failed, bounced back, or were rejected during processing.

intents.label: transfer_not_received_by_recipient
intents.definition: Enquiries where funds left the sender's account but have not yet arrived in the recipient's account.

intents.label: wrong_amount_of_cash_received
intents.definition: Disputes where an ATM dispensed less cash than requested while debiting the full amount.

intents.label: passcode_forgotten
intents.definition: Requests to reset or recover a forgotten mobile banking app login passcode.

intents.label: unable_to_verify_identity
intents.definition: Issues completing identity or document verification checks during account setup or review.
